newsitem.title: USA: U.S. awards $73 mln contract to Marinette Marine.
newsitem.headline: U.S. awards $73 mln contract to Marinette Marine.

text.p: The Marinette Marine Corp of Marinette, Wisconsin, has been awarded a $73 million contract to build an additional six 175-foot coastal buoy tenders, the U.S. Coast Guard said on Thursday.
It said the original contract to the firm, awarded in 1993, provided options for up to 14 ships, along with spare parts, training and a technical data package for support.
The Coast Guard said construction of the six new ships was scheduled to begin this year with delivery from 1999-2000.
